taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: JWE key/algorithm/context selection and decryption error handling
controls.source_trace: Trace untrusted protected/unprotected header choices into key/algorithm use and then into a purpose-specific validated payload.
controls.implementation_branch: Bind key selection and allowed alg/enc values to the recipient/context rather than trusting header choices. Successful decryption authenticates the ciphertext under a key, not necessarily its sender or tenant. Inspect any nested signature and application claims separately; differing local error text alone does not demonstrate an exploitable remote oracle.
controls.controlled_verification: Use local synthetic keys/ciphertexts and bounded valid/invalid cases; compare intended context with a wrong purpose/key/algorithm path without recovering production plaintext.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Different error messages alone do not prove a practical decryption oracle; decrypted bytes accepted for another purpose need separate evidence.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain algorithms/keys/context and uniform failure handling, retesting valid messages and prohibited combinations.
